profile.headline: Forward Deployed Engineer | Adobe Workfront | Bridging Product & Engineering | Scalable Web Technologies | Salt Lake City, UT
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
Forward Deployed Engineer | Salt Lake City, UT
I'm a Forward Deployed Engineer at Adobe Workfront, specializing in bridging the gap between product requirements and technical implementation. I work directly with customers to build, customize / optimize and deploy Adobe Workfront solutions, ensuring successful implementations and driving value realization.
What I do:
- Deploy and configure Adobe Workfront for enterprise customers
- Partner with product and engineering teams to translate customer needs into technical solutions
- Build integrations and extensions on the Workfront platform
- Provide technical guidance and best practices to customers and internal teams
- Troubleshoot complex implementation challenges in production environments
Previous Experience: Before Adobe Workfront, I focused on distributed systems, scalable web architectures, and ETL pipeline development. I've worked on building high-performance systems that handle significant scale and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Technical Skills: APIs, web technologies, system integration, problem-solving, customer collaboration, production deployment.

Connect with me if you're interested in Engineering solutions to directly meet customers needs, implementation architecture, or new technologies such as LLM / AI and Crypto.

positions.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
positions.description:
- Deploy and configure Adobe Workfront for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation
- Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to customize Workfront solutions for customer needs
- Build integrations and extensions on the Workfront platform using APIs and web technologies
- Provide technical troubleshooting and resolution for production implementation issues
- Conduct training and knowledge transfer for customer teams and internal stakeholders
- Partner with engineering to prioritize and deliver platform enhancements based on field feedback

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built out embedded application to Adobe's Creative Cloud products for use with the Adobe Workfront solution using React plugin technology, Node.js and GraphQL apis.
- Developed high throughput Metadata service in coordination with the Adobe AEM platform for asset mangement.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
2020-
Created Adobe Plugin for XD / Photoshop for use with integration to Workfront. 
- Kubernetes, helm, kubectl, docker
- React, Javascript
- Node.js, graphql and RESTful services.

2017-2020
First net-new product; Workfront Library from conception to a successful beta to released to customer. Supported taking the product from small usage to over a million in sales.
- AWS Cloud - Using Lambda Functions, Step functions, Neptune, S3, CloudFormation
- Redis, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB
- Event-sourcing, CQRS, serverless, microservices, distributed computing
- Java and Node.js

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on a Scrum Team of 5 developers and testers to complete a new financial system integrating with funders and Citibank. 
Built system to handle signature data using mutual authentication for payment processing 
Solved technical integration problems using systems for concurrent payment processing.

Technologies: 
Groovy, Java, MySQL, Casandra, Jersey, Grizzly, JMS, ActiveMQ, REST, Swagger, git

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Functioned as technical developer between 4 teams, working to complete projects and deliver fully functional systems. 
Worked on critical new business venture incorporating integration into various e-commerce sites and logistical partners. 
Used Neo4j, a GraphDB to build real time product attribute management system.
Other Technologies
Java 7, Oracle 11i, RESTful Webservices, Jersey, Neo4j, eBay Trading API

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Lead a group of senior software developers and testers, delivering working software in an iterative cycle. Used Jersey, Hibernate, and JMS as well as other technologies to provide both synchronous and asynchronous solutions. Completed the following projects successfully.

2012 eBay Channel Sales -
Designed, developed and maintained product and order services for integration with eBay. Synchronized inventory, pricing and other product details through highly responsive RESTful and JMS service. Maintained order state through scalable and interactive system order system. Also delivered HTML5 UI management tool.

2010 FraudSystem -
Developed scalable and responsible RESTful webservice for fraud detection. Utilized coherence for distributed caching. 

2008 International Orders - 
Integration with 3rd party freight forwarding service to provide order management to international locations. Developed both order forward and order reversal solutions.

2007 Paypal Website Integration - 
Workflow integration of Paypal into Overstock.com. Included integration into RESTful order management and payment systems.  

Responsibilities also included resume review, phone screens, onsite interviews as well as hiring.
